scope: Bounded exact experimental GPU beam suffix campaign; winner independently replayed from reset with the native exact oracle. Other campaign leaves were not individually native-replayed.
quality_limitation: The all-zero incumbent lineage was pruned at depth0 while candidates were nonterminal. Finite short-horizon score-first beam selection can sacrifice a later stronger combo. Completion-first ranking then filled the beam with terminal games at depth2.

historical_runtime_preservation.scope: immutable old binaries, original identities, generated inputs and source archive; restore this execution context to reproduce the historical run
